_readme: How far heals, buffs and debuffs reach, as tiles.
Nothing is recorded here yet. The wiki documents attack range as in-game
screenshots and does not document support reach at all, so every entry in
this file has to be read off the game by hand. The range recorder at
/contribute.html produces entries in exactly this shape.
Tiles use the same offsets as data/ranges.json: [column, row] from the tile
the Tatari stands on. Column is positive to the right. Row is NEGATIVE
towards the Zobos, so [0, -1] is one tile ahead and [0, 1] is one behind.
Kept separate from ranges.json rather than added to it under a flag, because
everything that reads ranges.json wants attack range and would otherwise have
to learn a distinction it has never needed.
Within each kind, entries are keyed the same way ranges.json keys them:
bySlug for one form, byLine for a whole evolution line keyed by its T1.
A per-slug entry wins over its line's.
Fields on an entry:
tiles     - required, the offsets
from      - required, where the reading came from
note      - optional, and the place to say so if you are unsure
verified  - optional. true once a maintainer has checked it by hand.
Absent means recorded but unchecked, which is not the same
thing and should not be shown as if it were.
